# ProductName

> Enterprise workflow automation platform

## Configure
- Configure HMAC authentication for inbound webhooks: Covers secure webhook authentication setup for docs, assistant responses, in-product hints, and automation workflows with one reusable module.
- [API playground](https://docs.example.com/reference/api-playground/): Interactive API reference with Swagger UI or Redoc and configurable sandbox behavior for product-led growth.
- [Apply a pilot, full, or RAG configuration](https://docs.example.com/how-to/apply-pipeline-configuration/): Update a client profile for pilot, full, or RAG-enabled operation and align it with cloud, strict-local, or hybrid LLM execution.
- [Assemble intent experiences](https://docs.example.com/how-to/assemble-intent-experiences/): Build user-intent documentation and channel bundles from reusable knowledge modules with validation, indexing, and consistent outputs.
- [Build your first workflow in 5 minutes](https://docs.example.com/getting-started/quickstart/): Create a webhook-triggered workflow that receives HTTP requests and sends Slack notifications. No coding required.
- [Canonical Flow (Sales + Delivery)](https://docs.example.com/operations/CANONICAL_FLOW/): Canonical sales and delivery flow for onboarding and operating client Auto-Doc Pipeline setups.
- [Choose a pipeline configuration](https://docs.example.com/getting-started/choose-pipeline-configuration/): Pick a pilot, full, or RAG-enabled bundle and pair it with cloud, strict-local, or hybrid execution in one guided setup.
- [Configure Ask AI module](https://docs.example.com/how-to/configure-ask-ai-module/): Enable or disable Ask AI, set provider and billing mode, and verify configuration in five steps for beginner operators.
- [Configure webhook triggers](https://docs.example.com/how-to/configure-webhook-trigger/): Set up and configure webhook trigger nodes to start workflows from incoming HTTP requests with authentication.
- [Install Ask AI runtime pack](https://docs.example.com/how-to/install-ask-ai-runtime-pack/): Install the optional Ask AI runtime pack with API endpoint, widget, auth checks, and billing hooks in a few commands.
- [Migrate documentation from Confluence](https://docs.example.com/how-to/migrate-from-confluence/): Import Confluence pages into the documentation pipeline with automatic quality enhancement, SEO optimization, and knowledge extraction.
- [Multi-Protocol Wizard Guide](https://docs.example.com/operations/MULTI_PROTOCOL_WIZARD_GUIDE/): Wizard UX for protocol-aware provisioning in VeriDoc and VeriOps.
- [Operator Runbook (Retainer Operations)](https://docs.example.com/operations/OPERATOR_RUNBOOK/): Step-by-step instructions for weekly report review, client questions, new repo setup, and profile tuning.
- [Run API-first production flow](https://docs.example.com/how-to/run-api-first-production-flow/): Generate OpenAPI from planning notes, run full lint and self-verification, publish playground assets, and keep a sandbox ready for client testing.
- [Set up a real-time webhook processing pipeline](https://docs.example.com/en/how-to/set-up-real-time-webhook-processing-pipeline/): Configure end-to-end webhook ingestion with HMAC verification, async queue processing, and delivery guarantees in under 15 minutes.
- [Smart Merge and Manual Review](https://docs.example.com/operations/SMART_MERGE_REVIEW/): How needs_review works for protocol test assets and where operators review flagged cases.
- [TaskStream API playground](https://docs.example.com/reference/taskstream-api-playground/): Interactive TaskStream OpenAPI playground with Swagger UI or Redoc and try-it-out requests against mock or prod-like sandbox endpoints.
- [Variables and Templates Guide](https://docs.example.com/VARIABLES_GUIDE/): How to use Jinja2 variables and templates in documentation for consistency

## Troubleshoot
- Define idempotent webhook retry handling: Provides retry and idempotency patterns to avoid duplicate processing across documentation, assistant guidance, and runbook automation.
- [Fix: Webhook trigger not firing](https://docs.example.com/troubleshooting/webhook-not-firing/): Troubleshoot Webhook nodes that do not receive requests. Common causes include inactive workflows, wrong URL type, and network configuration.
- [TaskStream API planning notes](https://docs.example.com/reference/taskstream-planning-notes/): Input planning notes used by the API-first flow to generate and validate OpenAPI contracts for TaskStream demos.
- [Troubleshooting Guide](https://docs.example.com/troubleshooting/): Solutions for common problems including webhook failures, credential errors, execution timeouts, and memory issues.

- [VeriDoc security policy](https://docs.example.com/legal/security-policy/): Security policy for VeriDoc platform covering infrastructure security, encryption, authentication, access controls, and incident response procedures.
